statements.status_notes: Debian fixed this for trixie in libevent 2.1.13-stable-1~deb13u1 (DSA-6493-1), which ships the upstream 2.1.13-stable point release, and the DHI build of that Debian version carries the fix. Upstream commit https://github.com/libevent/libevent/commit/5cb95ba2f804f8aff46f88d58391c71e1251cd1c resets outbuf->first, outbuf->last and outbuf->last_with_datap after evbuffer_add_buffer_reference frees the empty initial chain, so the following append no longer dereferences the freed chain. Checked by inspecting the DHI Debian packages on amd64 and arm64 with their debug symbols. The disassembly of evbuffer_add_buffer_reference in the libevent-2.1 and libevent-core-2.1 shared libraries contains the added stores that clear those pointers; builds without the fix do not. See https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-63381 and https://github.com/libevent/libevent/security/advisories/GHSA-c2pj-cg4r-88c8.
